facts.canopy: He stands on a stone chariot under a blue canopy studded with stars.
facts.wand-no-reins: In his right hand he holds a long wand with a pointed tip, and there are no reins anywhere.
facts.star-crown: On his head is a crown with a gold star ornament.
facts.armor-moons: He wears armor with a square plate on the chest and a crescent moon ornament on each shoulder.
facts.sphinxes: In front of him sit a black sphinx (left) and a white sphinx (right).
facts.winged-disc: On the front of the chariot are a winged disc and a shield with red markings.
facts.city-river: Behind him are a walled city with red roofs and a river.

glosses.wand-no-reins: He sets the direction by will, without reins.
glosses.sphinxes: Two different forces (black and white) have to be gathered in one direction.
glosses.city-river: A departure that leaves the familiar castle behind.

reversedGloss.blocked: Two forces pull different ways, and he cannot move ahead.
reversedGloss.excess: Speed and the urge to win go too far, and he misses what is around him.

misdescriptions.wrong: He is gripping the reins and driving.
